title: [jsDelivr]: push the sourcemap
body:
https://github.com/jsdelivr/jsdelivr/tree/master/files/jquery/2.1.4 jquery is doing it so let's do it :)

TODO:
- [x] generate and push the sourcemap in jsdelivr (only need to do a release)
- [x] check that the sourcemap is downloaded

comments.body: Is downloading the companion .map an automatic behavior from browsers or do we need to do something to indicate where it is?

The main file should contain a comment referencing the filemap location. Something like `//# sourceMappingURL=bundle.js.map`.

Tools that generate sourcemaps usually update the original file as well. We'll just have to push both to jsdelivr.
